messages:
deploy-bot: publish aborted for images/service-api:release-20260320 - provenance check failed. manifest.annotations.build_id mismatch across regions (us-east-1: build-452 vs eu-west-1: build-449). halting rollout and pinning previous digest.

maria: seeing this too in the build logs. the eu mirror got an older manifest after the multi-arch push completed. :confused:

alex: do we have the pinned stable digest handy so we can roll back traffic?

ethan: stable digest is sha256:3a7f9b2c8d4e6f1b5c2e9a6d7f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8 (service-api:stable). we can canary that immediately.

maria: will start canary rollback in us-east-1 now. can someone handle the retag/publish? we need a unique build tag so provenance aligns everywhere.

zoe: I can retag from CI artifacts. plan: pull by digest, tag as release-20260320+ci452, push to eu-west-1 and us-east-1, then re-run provenance attestation sync job.

ci-bot: queued job #8721: retag-and-push(service-api @ sha256:3a7f...). logs: 
```
+ docker pull 123456789.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/service-api@sha256:3a7f9b2c...
+ docker tag 123456789.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/service-api@sha256:3a7f... 123456789.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/service-api:release-20260320+ci452
+ docker push 123456789.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/service-api:release-20260320+ci452
```

alex: once pushed, we should copy the cosign attestation to the eu repo and re-run deploy-bot checks. don't want a repeat.

ethan: agreed. i'll run the attestation copy helper: `scripts/attest-copy --from us-east-1 --to eu-west-1 --repo service-api --tag release-20260320+ci452` then trigger deploy-bot resume.

maria: timeline: retag + push ~5m, attest copy ~3m, wait for propagation ~2m, then resume rollout. total ~10-15m within our change window.

sre-oncall: i'll monitor latency/5xx during the canary and have rollback playbook ready. alert thresholds set. :eyes:

zoe: note for release notes: call out that original release was paused due to cross-region manifest annotation mismatch; fixed by republishing with build-specific tag and syncing attestations. add to changelog under 'Deployment notes'.

maria: posting brief notify in #general and updating the release PR with the new tag and the stable digest fallback.

deploy-bot: resume requested for images/service-api:release-20260320+ci452 - initial checks pass, canary rollout starting in us-east-1. :shipit:
